explanation.summary: The model ranks HEALTHY first with posterior 1.00 (temperature-calibrated, m=10 windows). The out-of-model check flags this input, so the ranking should be treated as unreliable here.
supporting_evidence: No knowledge-graph edge of the top cause carries a large contribution.
conflicts_or_unexplained: Out-of-model check: the Mahalanobis residual 72.1 exceeds the reference threshold 44.3; the data are not well explained by any hypothesis.
caveats: Edge weights and the covariance are learned from simulated windows, so they inherit the simulator's assumptions (nominal parameters above the stability limit, assumed fault severities and gains).
Knowledge-graph edges and signs are physics reasoning with provenance tier ASSUMED, tested only against simulated data.
The posterior is temperature-calibrated on simulated validation draws; calibration on real data has not been tested.
No real multi-cause labelled data exist, so the ranking has not been validated on real cuts.
